blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We introduce QuadTok, a novel framework for visual tokenization and autoregressive image generation. Compared to traditional approaches using 2D grids or 1D token sequences, we propose a hierarchical quadtree structure, bridging the gap between 2D spatial binding and 1D sequence-level flexibility. The QuadTok tokenizer dynamically allocates representational capacity to visually intricate areas while leaving homogeneous regions at a coarse resolution. Compared with a fixed 256-token grid, our ImageNet-trained tokenizer saves approximately 10% of tokens on ImageNet and 9% when transferred zero-shot to COCO dataset, while maintaining comparable reconstruction fidelity. Furthermore, the natural causality introduced by the tree structure seamlessly enables autoregressive image generation. Conditioned on a quadtree topology supplied before generation, our 947M GPT-style generative model achieves a 2.08 gFID on the ImageNet 256 × 256 256\times 256 benchmark. Additionally, leveraging the strong spatial correlation preserved by the quadtree structure, the QuadTok generator enables zero-shot spatially controlled image generation capabilities. Code: https://github.com/myc634/QuadTok .
blocks.zh: 我们引入了"QuadTok",一个视觉象征化和自发回向图像生成的新框架. 相较于使用2D格子或1D令牌序列的传统方法,我们提出分级四树结构,弥合了2D空间绑定和1D序列级灵活性之间的差距. QuadTok符号化器动态地将代表能力分配给视觉复杂地区,同时将同质地区置于粗糙的分辨率之下。 与固定的256个托肯网格相比,我们的ImageNet训练的活化器在ImageNet上节省了大约10%的活化物,在将零射入COCO数据集时节省了9%,同时保持了可比较的重建忠心. 此外,由树状结构引入的自然因果关系无缝地能够自动地生成图像。 我们的947M GPT式基因模型在ImageNet256 × 256\times 256基准上实现了2.08克FID。 此外,利用由四面体结构保存的强烈空间相关性,QuadTok生成器使零发空间控制图像生成能力成为可能。 代码:https://github.com/myc634/QuadTok.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Natural images exhibit highly non-uniform spatial information density: regions containing intricate textures and high-frequency patterns carry significantly more information than smooth or homogeneous areas. Ideally, a visual tokenizer should allocate representational capacity according to this spatial variability. However, classic visual tokenizers ( van den Oord et al., 2018 ; Sun et al., 2024 ) compress images into rigid 2D grids with a fixed token budget, distributing tokens uniformly across the image regardless of local complexity. As a result, complex regions are often under-represented while simple regions are over-allocated with redundant tokens.
blocks.zh: 自然图像显示高度非统一空间信息密度:含有复杂纹理和高频图案的区域携带的信息比平滑或同质区域多得多。 理想的情况是,视标器应根据这种空间可变性分配代表能力。 然而,经典的可视化活化器(van den Oord等,2018;Sun等,2024)用固定的活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活 因此,复杂的区域往往代表性不足,而简单的区域则过多地分配了多余的标志。

blocks.en: To overcome the rigidity of grid-based tokenization, recent work has explored 1D visual tokenizers ( Shen et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2024b ; Duggal et al., 2024 ; Miwa et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Bachmann et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . These methods model images as sequential token streams and allow for variable length, offering greater flexibility in adapting the token budget to image complexity. Nevertheless, this flexibility comes at the cost of spatial awareness. Because token allocation occurs along the sequence dimension rather than the image plane, these approaches remain largely spatially agnostic. Consequently, they often lack explicit correspondence between tokens and image patches, which can degrade pixel-level fidelity and make them less suitable for downstream tasks that require spatially grounded representations and precise localization.
blocks.zh: 为了克服网格化的僵硬性,最近的工作探索了1D可视化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活 这些方法将图像模拟为相继的符号流并允许可变长度,在使符号预算适应图像复杂性方面提供了更大的灵活性. 然而,这种灵活性是以空间意识为代价的。 由于符号分配发生在顺序维度上而不是图像平面上,这些方法在很大程度上仍然是空间不可知的. 因此,它们往往缺乏符号和图像补丁之间的明确对应关系,这可以降低像素级的忠诚度,使其更不适合下游任务,因为下游任务需要空间化的表示和精确的本地化.

blocks.en: In this work, we propose QuadTok , a novel quadtree-based visual tokenizer that enables adaptive token allocation while preserving explicit spatial correspondence. Instead of relying on a rigid grid or a purely sequential representation, QuadTok represents images using a hierarchical quadtree structure that dynamically subdivides spatial regions based on local complexity. This design bridges the gap between existing paradigms: it retains the spatial grounding of traditional 2D tokenizers while introducing the sequence-level flexibility of 1D token representations. However, one key challenge remains: How can we select which regions to refine based on their reconstruction benefit?
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们提出"QuadTok",这是一种以四棵树为基础的新型视觉示意剂,它既能进行适应性地分配,又能保持清晰的空间相通. QuadTok不依赖僵硬的网格或纯粹相继的表示,而是使用分级的四树结构来代表图像,这种结构根据地处复杂程度来动态地细分空间区域. 这种设计弥补了现有范式之间的差距:它保留了传统2D活化活化器的空间地平面,同时引入了1D活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活化活. 然而,一个关键的挑战仍然是: 我们怎样才能根据重建收益来选择改进哪些区域?

blocks.en: To tackle this, we propose Region-Wise Complexity Guidance , a data-driven strategy to select a content-adaptive tree for each image based on reconstruction benefit. Furthermore, we identify that maintaining the hierarchical causality and explicit spatial relationships between tree nodes is crucial during the tokenization process. To enforce this structural integrity, we introduce the Kinship Causal Mask . This mechanism dictates a strict coarse-to-fine information flow along the quadtree hierarchy, allowing the global image structure to be established before localized refinement occurs within spatially bounded regions.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这个问题,我们提出了区域-Wise Complexity Guide(区域-Wise Complexity Guide),这是一个由数据驱动的战略,根据重建收益为每个图像选择一个内容适应树. 此外,我们认为,在标志化过程中,保持树节点之间的等级因果关系和明确的空间关系至关重要。 为了强化这种结构完整性,我们引入了"金船"(Kinship Causal Mask). 这一机制要求沿四棵树结构进行严格的粗放到精细的信息流动,从而可以在空间界限内进行局部完善之前建立全球图像结构。

blocks.en: Empowered by our Region-Wise Complexity Guidance , the QuadTok tokenizer achieves an rFID of 1.46 and a PSNR of 20.37 on ImageNet with 230 tokens on average, saving approximately 10% relative to a fixed 256-token grid. Transferred zero-shot to COCO, the same tokenizer uses 232 tokens on average, saving approximately 9%. Furthermore, leveraging the causality inherent in the quadtree structure, the QuadTok 947M autoregressive generator achieves a gFID of 2.08, compared with 2.15 for the 1.4B RandAR-XXL model ( Pang et al., 2025 ) . We also show a consistent scaling behavior on our generator across different model scales. Furthermore, guided by the explicit quadtree topology, QuadTok generator enables novel zero-shot capabilities such as spatially controllable generation.
blocks.zh: QuadTok的标致器通过我们区域-智慧复杂度指导,在ImageNet上实现了1.46的RFID和20.37的PSNR,平均配有230个令牌,相对于固定的256个托肯电网,节省了约10%。 向COCO转移零发,同一种活化剂平均使用232个活化剂,节省了约9%. 此外,利用四方结构固有的因果关系,QuadTok 947M自递式发电机的GFID为2.08,而1.4B RandAR-XXL模型的GFID为2.15(Pang等人,2025年)。 我们还在发电机上 显示一个一致的缩放行为 跨越不同的模型尺度。 此外,以明确的四棵树地貌为取向,QuadTok生成器使新颖的零射出能力,例如空间可控生成。

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose QuadTok , a quadtree-based visual tokenizer that replaces fixed-grid representations with spatially adaptive token allocation. Our approach preserves explicit spatial correspondence while enabling flexible token budgets driven by local visual complexity. • We introduce two key mechanisms to support adaptive tokenization: (i) Region-Wise Complexity Guidance strategy selecting regional refinement from reconstruction benefit; (ii) a Kinship Causal Mask enforcing hierarchical dependencies among tree nodes during tokenization. • Leveraging the hierarchical causality of quadtrees, QuadTok achieves competitive image generation quality while enabling zero-shot spatially controllable image synthesis conditioned on quadtree layouts supplied before generation.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献概述如下: 我们提议四面体(QuadTok),一种基于四面体的视觉比喻剂,用空间适应的比克分配代替了固定的比克表示. 我们的做法保留了明确的空间通信,同时能够以当地视觉复杂性为驱动,编制灵活的象征性预算。 我们引入了两个支持适应性标志化的关键机制:(一) 区域-Wise 复杂度 指导性战略,从重建收益中选择区域完善;(二) 建立Kinship Causal Mask,在标志化期间在树节点之间加强等级依赖。 • 利用四棵树的分级因果关系,QuadTok实现具有竞争力的图像生成质量,同时使零发空间可控图像合成以四棵树在生成前提供的布局为条件。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Visual Tokenization
blocks.zh: 2.1 可视化

blocks.en: Visual tokenizers compress images into representations for generative modeling. VQ-VAE ( van den Oord et al., 2018 ) learns discrete codebooks, and VQ-GAN ( Esser et al., 2021 ) adds adversarial training to improve perceptual reconstruction. Later work improves codebook design and tokenizer architectures ( Lee et al., 2022 ; Mentzer et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2024a ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) . Beyond fixed spatial grids, TiTok ( Yu et al., 2024b ) represents images as compact 1D sequences. FlexTok ( Bachmann et al., 2025a ) and One-D-Piece ( Miwa et al., 2025b ) support variable sequence lengths, while GigaTok ( Xiong et al., 2025 ) uses semantic regularization to improve reconstruction and downstream generation as tokenizers scale. QuadTok focuses on assigning discrete tokens to regions within an image while retaining an explicit spatial correspondence.
blocks.zh: 视觉示意器将图像压缩成表达,用于基因模型. VQ-VAE(van den Oord等,2018年)学习了离散的密码本,而VQ-GAN(Esser等,2021年)则增加了对抗训练来改善知觉重建. 后来的作品改进了编码本的设计和装饰器建筑(Lee等,2022;Mentzer等,2024;Yu等,2024a; 赵等,2024. ). 在固定空间网格之外,TiTok(Yu等,2024b)代表图像为紧凑的1D序列. FlexTok (Bachmann等,2025a)和One-D-Piece (Miwa等,2025b)支持可变序列长度,而GigaTok (Xiong等,2025)则使用语义规范来改善重建和下游生成作为活化器规模. QuadTok侧重于在图像内向区域分配离散的符号,同时保留明确的空间对应.

blocks.en: CAT ( Shen et al., 2025 ) adapts representation capacity to image complexity by using caption-derived scores to select an image-wide compression ratio in a nested continuous VAE. Its variable-length latents support image synthesis with a diffusion transformer. QuadTok instead allocates discrete tokens at different spatial resolutions within each image, preserving explicit correspondence between tokens and regions. During reconstruction, image content determines which regions to refine; during generation, an autoregressive model predicts visual codes under a topology supplied before sampling. We compare with CAT’s published ImageNet 512 × 512 512\times 512 generation results in Tab. 7 , alongside other high-resolution generators.
blocks.zh: CAT(Shen等,2025年)通过使用字幕衍生分数在嵌入式连续VAE中选择一个全图像压缩比来使表现能力适应图像复杂性. 它的可变长潜伏能用扩散变压器支持图像合成. 取而代之的是,QuadTok在每个图像中以不同的空间分辨率分配离散的符号,保留了符号和区域之间的明确对应. 在重建期间,图像内容决定了哪些区域需要精炼;在生成期间,一个自旋模型在采样前提供的地貌下预测可视化代码. 我们与CAT出版的"影像网"(ImageNet)512 × 512 512\times 512生成结果相提并论, 7,与其它高分辨率发电机一起.

blocks.en: 2.2 Autoregressive Image Generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 自动后退图像生成

blocks.en: Autoregressive image models differ in both their latent representation and prediction unit ( Lee et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Shan et al., 2026 ) . LlamaGen ( Sun et al., 2024 ) predicts discrete grid tokens sequentially, RandAR ( Pang et al., 2025 ) changes their generation order, and VAR ( Tian et al., 2024 ) predicts successive resolution scales. DPAR ( Srivastava et al., 2025 ) uses an entropy model to group discrete tokens into variable-length patches, reducing the sequence processed by its global transformer. We compare with DPAR as a related approach to spatial token aggregation. QuadTok represents regions directly as quadtree nodes and generates their discrete codes in breadth-first order conditioned on the given tree.
blocks.zh: 自动回转图像模型在潜在表达和预测单位上都有所不同(Lee等,2022;Li等,2024;Shan等,2026)。 LlamaGen (Sun等, 2024年) 相继预测出离散的网格符号,RandAR (Pang等, 2025年) 改变它们的生成顺序,而VAR (Tian等, 2024年) 预测出相继的分辨率尺度. DPAR(Srivastava等,2025年)使用py模型将离散的活字符号组合为可变长补丁,减少了由它的全球变压器所处理的序列. 我们与DPAR进行比较,作为空间符号聚合的相关方法. QuadTok直接代表区域作为四棵树节点,并以给定树上的宽第一顺序生成它们的离散代码.

blocks.en: Continuous-token methods provide another approach to autoregressive synthesis. xAR ( Ren et al., 2025a ) generalizes the prediction unit to entities such as cells and uses flow matching with noisy contexts. FlowAR ( Ren et al., 2025b ) combines scale-wise autoregression with flow matching. QuadTok models variable-length discrete sequences with explicit regional correspondence, allowing generation to be conditioned on a supplied spatial topology.
blocks.zh: 连续式方法为自递式合成提供了另一种方法. xAR (Ren等, 2025a)将预测单位概括到细胞等实体,并使用与吵闹上下文相匹配的流量. FlowAR (Ren等, 2025b) 将规模自回与流量相匹配相结合. 四方 Tok模型可变长离散序列带有明显的区域对应,允许以所提供的空间地貌为生成条件.

blocks.en: 2.3 Quadtree Representations in Vision
blocks.zh: 2.3 远景中的四方代表

blocks.en: Quadtrees recursively partition two-dimensional space and have been used for image processing, compression, and adaptive visual computation ( Wu, 2018 ; Tang et al., 2022 ; Ronen et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) . QuadTok incorporates this hierarchy into a generative visual tokenizer. Its topology-aware attention preserves structured interactions among tokens, and its discrete representation supports image reconstruction and autoregressive synthesis under a supplied spatial topology.
blocks.zh: Quadtrees递归分出二维空间,并被用于图像处理,压缩,并适应视觉计算(Wu,2018;Tang等,2022;Ronen等,2023;Zhao等,2025.). 四方 托克将这一等级纳入到基因可视化活化剂中. 它的地貌意识的注意保留了地物之间的有结构的相互作用,它的离散表现支持了在所提供空间地貌下图像的再生和自递回合成.

blocks.en: 3.1 QuadTok Tokenizer
blocks.zh: 3.1 四方会议 切换器

blocks.en: We introduce QuadTok, a visual tokenizer that represents images using an adaptive quadtree structure. Unlike conventional methods that rely on fixed grids, QuadTok dynamically allocates tokens across regions while maintaining explicit correspondence between tokens and the image patches.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了QuadTok,一种视觉示意器,它用适应性的四树结构来代表图像. 与依赖固定网格的常规方法不同,QuadTok在保持信使与图像补丁之间明确对应的同时,动态地将信使分配跨区域.

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Quadtree Representation
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 四方代表制

blocks.en: QuadTok represents an image using a hierarchical quadtree decomposition, where each node corresponds to a spatial region and is treated as a visual token. A node is defined by the attribute tuple ( l , p ) (l,p) , where l l denotes the tree level and p p the spatial index. Level l = 1 l=1 represents coarse regions of the image, while level l = 2 l=2 corresponds to higher-resolution subdivisions. Each parent node may expand into four child nodes covering its spatial quadrants. Our default configuration uses two levels; we also evaluate a three-level extension in Secs. 4.1 and 4.2.
blocks.zh: QuadTok 代表一个使用分级四树分解的图像,其中每个节点对应一个空间区域并被作为视觉符号处理. 节点由属性tuple(l,p)所定义 (l,p),其中l表示树级和p表示空间指数. l级=1 = 1 代表图像粗细区域,而l级=2 = 2 对应高分辨. 每个家长节点可扩展为四个孩子节点,覆盖其空间四角. 我们的默认配置使用两个级别;我们还评估了Secs 4.1和4.2中的三级扩展.

blocks.en: To interface this hierarchical structure with Transformer architecture, the quadtree is serialized into a 1D sequence using breadth-first search (BFS) traversal. This ordering first lists all coarse tokens and then their corresponding higher-resolution child tokens, naturally aligning with coarse-to-fine generation.
blocks.zh: 要将这种分级结构与"变形器"架构相接,用宽先搜索(BFS)traversal将四面体串行为一D序列. 这个顺序首先列出所有粗细的代币,然后列出相应的高分辨的儿童代币,自然与粗细相配.

blocks.en: 3.1.5 Tree-Structure Sampling
blocks.zh: 3.1.5 树木结构取样

blocks.en: Although the tokenizer can operate on arbitrary quadtree structures, training with a fixed fully expanded tree would cause the model to rely on a deterministic token layout. To improve robustness to variable tree structures, we employ a probabilistic tree sampling strategy during training.
blocks.zh: 尽管标致器可以在任意的四树结构上操作,但用固定的完全被拓宽的树来训练会使模型依赖于决定性的标致器布局. 为了提高可变树木结构的稳健性,我们在培训期间采用了概率树采样策略.

blocks.en: Instead of always using a fully expanded quadtree, we randomly sample valid subtrees for each training iteration. All level- 1 1 nodes are always retained to preserve the global image layout, while each parent node independently expands into its four child nodes with probability γ \gamma . When a parent node is not expanded, its spatial region remains represented solely by the coarse-level token.
blocks.zh: 我们不总是使用一个完全扩展的四棵树,而是随机抽取每个训练迭代的有效子树. 所有关- 1 1 个节点总是被保留,以保存全局图像布局,而每个父节点独立地扩展为它的4个子节点,概率为 γ\gamma. 当母节点没有被扩展时,其空间区域仍然完全由粗等符所代表.

blocks.en: This stochastic sampling exposes the tokenizer to diverse tree configurations and sequence lengths during training. As a result, the model learns to produce consistent representations under both coarse and refined token layouts, enabling it to robustly process the adaptive tree structures used during complexity-guided tokenization (to be introduced in Sec. 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 这种有花样的采样使标致器在训练期间暴露出不同的树构型和花序长度. 因此,该模型在粗细和精细的符号布局下学习产生一致的表示,使其能强有力地处理复杂指向符号化期间使用的适应性树结构(将引入第3.3节.

blocks.en: 3.2 Kinship Causal Attention
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 亲子关系 因果关系

blocks.en: Flattening the quadtree into a 1D sequence removes the explicit hierarchical constraints of the original structure. Without additional restrictions, standard self-attention would allow tokens to interact globally, potentially breaking the spatial correspondence between tokens and their associated image regions. To preserve the hierarchical topology, we introduce Kinship Causal Attention , a topology-aware masking strategy that constrains attention according to the quadtree structure.
blocks.zh: 将四棵树平整为一D序列会去除原有结构的明显的分级限制. 如果没有其他限制,标准的自我注意将使信使能够在全球范围内互动,有可能打破信使与其相关图像区域之间的空间对应。 为了保护地貌结构,我们引入了Kinship Causal Content(Kinship Causal Content),这是一种地貌意识的遮掩策略,根据四面体结构限制注意力.

blocks.en: During encoding, the Aggregator Transformer processes the concatenated sequence [ F ∥ Q ] [F\parallel Q] of ViT feature tokens F F and quadtree instruction tokens Q Q . Attention is asymmetric: ViT tokens attend bidirectionally among themselves, and quadtree tokens attend to all ViT tokens, but not vice versa. Tree tokens thus draw on globally contextualized image features, while their region and level embeddings specify the regions they represent.
blocks.zh: 在编码过程中,聚合变形器处理由ViT特性符F和四棵树指示符Q的相接序列[F·Q·Q][F\相接Q]. 注意不对称: ViT标志在它们之间双向排列,四棵树标志在所有ViT标志上排列,但反之亦然. 因此,树标语取自全球背景图像特征,而树标语所嵌入的区域和层次则指定它们所代表的区域。

blocks.en: During decoding, the Decoder Transformer processes the quantized visual tokens together with their corresponding quadtree instruction tokens. In both the encoding and decoding stages, the self-attention interactions among quadtree tokens are governed by our proposed Kinship Causal Mask , which enforces a strict coarse-to-fine dependency consistent with the quadtree hierarchy.
blocks.zh: 在解码过程中,解码器变形器会处理被分解的可视化符号及其相应的四树指示符号. 在编码和解码两个阶段,四棵树象征物之间的自觉互动由我们提出的Kinship Causal Mask来管理,它强制实行与四棵树等级一致的严格粗对细依赖.

blocks.en: This mask is used within the tokenizer, whereas the autoregressive generator uses a standard causal mask over the BFS token sequence. For the two-level tokenizer, the Kinship Causal Mask follows three structural rules:

blocks.en: 3.3 Region-wise Complexity Guided Tokenization
blocks.zh: 3.3 区域复杂程度

blocks.en: While the tokenizer can process arbitrary tree structures, we must determine which regions should be refined for a given image. Intuitively, regions containing complex textures require finer-level tokens, whereas homogeneous regions can remain coarse. We measure regional complexity using reconstruction benefit . A region is considered complex if reconstructing it with finer-level tokens significantly improves perceptual fidelity. To estimate this efficiently, we perform a probing procedure. We randomly expand half of the coarse regions to form a probing tree and construct its complementary tree where the remaining regions are expanded. This balanced design allows each region to appear once in an expanded state and once in a collapsed state, enabling efficient estimation of the regional reconstruction benefit for all regions simultaneously. The image is reconstructed under both tree structures, producing two outputs. We compute a spatial LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) loss map between each reconstruction and the original image I I . For a region r r , let E r collapsed E_{r}^{\mathrm{collapsed}} and E r expanded E_{r}^{\mathrm{expanded}} denote the loss maps from the probing reconstructions in which that region is collapsed and expanded, respectively. Its estimated regional reconstruction benefit is b r = AvgPool r ⁡ ( E r collapsed − E r expanded ) b_{r}=\operatorname{AvgPool}_{r}\!\left(E_{r}^{\mathrm{collapsed}}-E_{r}^{\mathrm{expanded}}\right) . Here, AvgPool r \operatorname{AvgPool}_{r} averages the loss difference over the spatial extent of region r r . A positive b r b_{r} indicates that expansion reduces reconstruction error relative to the input image.

The topology is selected before sampling, but node instructions are presented in BFS order. At step i i , the model can use only the current and preceding node instructions, not future nodes.

blocks.en: We parameterize this distribution using a LLaMA ( Touvron et al., 2023 ) -style decoder-only Transformer with a standard causal attention mask. Each visual-token prediction depends only on preceding visual codes and the supplied conditioning information; the tokenizer’s bidirectional parent and sibling interactions are not used in the generator. Structural instruction embeddings encode the quadtree geometry, which specifies both the tree level and spatial position of each token, enabling the model to condition generation on spatial hierarchy.
blocks.zh: 我们使用一个LLaMA(Touvron等,2023年)——带有标准因果关注口罩的风格解码器-唯一变形器来参数化这种分布. 每个可视化的预测只取决于之前的可视化代码和所提供的条件信息;指示器的双向父和兄弟间互动不用于生成器. 结构指令嵌入了"四树几何"的编码,它规定了每个符的树平和空间位置,使模型能够以空间分级为生成条件.

blocks.en: During inference, tokens are generated sequentially in BFS order. Coarse tokens appear first, establishing the global structure, after which finer tokens progressively refine local details and textures.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We present QuadTok, a quadtree-based tokenizer that enables spatially adaptive, variable-length visual representations. By organizing tokens in a quadtree structure, QuadTok allocates tokens according to local complexity while preserving spatial correspondence between tokens and image regions which bridges adaptive tokenization and structured spatial representations. Experiments show that QuadTok achieves strong reconstruction and generation performance while enabling zero-shot spatial layout control. While this work focuses on class-conditional generation, QuadTok is compatible with multimodal pipelines and text-to-image generation, which we leave for future work.
blocks.zh: 我们呈现出QuadTok,一种以四棵树为基点的活化剂,能够进行空间适应性,可变长的视觉表现. QuadTok通过在四棵树结构中组织指使,根据当地的复杂性分配指使,同时保留指使和图像区域之间的空间对应,将适应性指使和结构化的空间表示相接. 实验显示,QuadTok实现了强大的再生和生成性能,同时实现了零发空间布局控制. 这项工作的重点是阶级条件生成,而QuadTok则与多式联运管道和文本到图像生成兼容,我们留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: Appendix B QuadTok Tokenizer Training Details
blocks.zh: 附录B QuadTok Tokenizer 培训细节

blocks.en: We train the QuadTok tokenizer on the ImageNet-1K training set at a resolution of 256 × 256 256\times 256 . The Encoder adopts a Vision Transformer (ViT) backbone comprising 8x Transformer ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) blocks with a patch size of 16 × 16 16\times 16 and learnable positional embeddings ( Heo et al., 2024 ; Su et al., 2023 ) . The Aggregator and Decoder modules follow a similar architecture, each containing 8x Transformer ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) blocks, but we only apply structural instruction embedding instead using standard position embedding widly using in Visiton Transformer.
blocks.zh: 我们以256×256256\times 256的分辨率,在ImageNet-1K训练装置上训练出QuadTok表示器。 编码器采用了由8x变形器(Vaswani等,2017年)块组成的视野变形器(ViT)骨干,补丁大小为16×16 16\times 16并可以学习位置嵌入(Heo等,2024;Su等,2023年). 聚合器和解码器模块遵循了类似的架构,每个模块包含8x变形器(Vaswani等,2017年)块,但我们只应用了结构指令嵌入法,取而代之的是使用在Vision变形器中使用的标准位置嵌入法.

blocks.en: The hidden embedding dimension across all modules is fixed at 512 512 . Following LlamaGen ( Sun et al., 2024 ) , we employ a shared codebook across all tree levels with vocabulary size V = 16384 V=16384 and latent dimensionality d = 8 d=8 . During training, probabilistic tree sampling is applied with child node expansion probability γ = 0.5 \gamma=0.5 , which balances computational efficiency and reconstruction fidelity. The tokenizer contains approximately 120 120 M parameters.
blocks.zh: 所有模块的隐藏嵌入维度被固定为512 512. 继LlamaGen(Sun等,2024年)之后,我们使用一个跨越所有树级的共享代码簿,词汇大小为V=16384 V=16384,潜在维度为d=8 d=8. 在培训期间,采用概率树采样方法,儿童节点扩展概率为 γ = 0.5\gamma = 0.5,平衡了计算效率和重建忠心。 标致器包含约120个120M参数.

blocks.en: For the quadtree structure, we use two depth levels with spatial token grids of 8 × 8 8\times 8 and 16 × 16 16\times 16 . Following LlamaGen ( Sun et al., 2024 ) , we use a shared codebook across tree levels with vocabulary size V = 16384 V=16384 and latent dimension d = 8 d=8 . During training, probabilistic tree sampling is applied with child expansion probability γ = 0.5 \gamma=0.5 , balancing computational efficiency and reconstruction fidelity. In total, the tokenizer contains approximately 120 120 M parameters.

ℒ V ​ Q \mathcal{L}_{VQ} represents the Vector Quantization commitment loss necessary to align the continuous visual representations with the discrete codebook. blocks.en: Appendix C QuadTok Generator Training Details
blocks.zh: 附录C 四方托克发电机培训详情

blocks.en: The architecture of the QuadTok generator follows the decoder-only Autoregressive(AR) generation paradigm adopted in LlamaGen ( Sun et al., 2024 ) . We incorporate several modern architectural components, including Query-Key (QK) Normalization ( Henry et al., 2020 ) , SwiGLU activation functions ( Shazeer, 2020 ) , and Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE) ( Heo et al., 2024 ) . We scale the two-level generator across four model sizes: 111M (B), 343M (L), 697M (XL), and 947M (XXL) parameters. The three-level generator contains 344M parameters. All models are trained for 300 epochs (approximately 360K iterations) using a global batch size of 1024 1024 , without applying exponential moving average (EMA) to the model weights. Optimization is performed using the AdamW ( Kingma and Ba, 2014 ) optimizer with β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 , β 2 = 0.95 \beta_{2}=0.95 , and weight decay 0.05 0.05 . The learning rate is set to 4 × 10 − 4 4\times 10^{-4} for the first 250 epochs without warm-up, followed by a linear decay to 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} over the final 50 epochs. To mitigate overfitting and enable Classifier-Free Guidance ( Ho and Salimans, 2022b ; Ho and Salimans, 2022a ) (CFG), the class conditioning embeddings are randomly dropped with probability 0.1 0.1 during training.
blocks.zh: QuadTok生成器的架构遵循了LlamaGen(Sun等,2024年)所采纳的解码器唯一自递(AR)生成范式. 我们纳入了几个现代建筑构件,包括Query-Key(QK) Normalization(Henry等,2020年),SwiGLU活化功能(Shazeer,2020年)和Rotary Place Embeddings(ROPE)(Heo等,2024年). 我们将双层发电机的分级分为4个型号:111M(B),343M(L),697M(XL)和947M(XXL)参数. 三级发电机包含344M参数. 所有型号都经过了300个纪元(约360K迭代)的训练,使用全球分批量大小为1024-1024,而不对型号权重适用指数移动平均值(EMA). 优化是使用 AdamW(Kingma and Ba,2014年) 优化器进行,其中β 1 = 0.9\βa_{1}=0.9,β 2 = 0.95\βa_{2}=0.95,重量衰减为0.050.05. 学分被设定为4×10−4 4.4\times 10×4}前250个没有取暖的纪元,再到最后50个纪元的1×10−5 1\times 10×5}出现线性衰变. 为了缓解过度调整,并启用无分级指导(Ho and Salimans, 2022b;Ho and Salimans, 2022a)(CFG),在训练时会以概率0.1 0.1随机地降下分级调节嵌入.

blocks.en: During inference, we employ a standard Key-Value (KV) cache to accelerate autoregressive decoding, together with a dynamic power-cosine CFG scheduler to improve sample fidelity. A key characteristic of our framework is that the quadtree topology must be predefined before generation.
blocks.zh: 在推论期间,我们使用标准的键-Value (KV)缓存来加速自旋解码,同时使用动态动力-Cosine CFG调度器来提高样本的忠心. 我们框架的一个关键特征是,四树地貌必须先预先确定。

blocks.en: Quadtree structure during inference. For class-conditional ImageNet evaluation, we sample quadtree topologies independently of image content using a probabilistic expansion policy. Each sampled topology specifies the regions to refine, and its node instructions are presented in breadth-first order as the generator predicts visual codes.
blocks.zh: 推论期间的四方树结构. 对于类有条件的ImageNet评价,我们使用概率扩张政策,对四棵树的地貌进行独立于图像内容的采样. 每个被取样的地貌都指定了需要精炼的区域,其节点指示按宽度第一顺序排列,因为生成器会预测视觉编码.

LlamaGen VQ-16和所发行的TiTok L-32,B-64,和S-128等变体使用固定托肯编码器. 比较测量实际的预处理管,不匹配编码器架构. 在批量尺寸为128时,QuadTok处理161.66个图像/s,而LlamaGen VQ-16处理346.58个图像;额外费用支持依赖图像的区域分配。 所测量的平均符数与数据集全重建平均值略有不同,因为时间使用固定的验证前缀.

blocks.en: We evaluate the frozen two-level ImageNet-trained generator and tokenizer using CFG scale 6, a power-cosine guidance schedule with exponent 1, and sampling temperature 1. Each condition contains 20 images for each of 50 fixed ImageNet classes, giving 1,000 images per condition.

blocks.en: The four prescribed layouts correspond to the left, right, top, and bottom half-planes. Each topology retains all nodes of an 8 × 8 8\times 8 coarse grid and expands the 32 cells in the target half-plane, adding four children per cell for a total of 192 visual tokens. The matched random baseline uniformly selects exactly 32 coarse cells for expansion independently for each image. Its generated image set is shared across the four directional evaluations.

blocks.en: Grad-CAM uses the intended class in ResNet-50. Box localization uses the highest-confidence intended-object box from Grounding DINO, and SAM 2 receives that box as its mask prompt. The Grad-CAM center of mass, box center, or mask centroid is tested against the requested half-plane. Box and mask scores count missed detections as failures and use all generated images as the denominator.
blocks.zh: Grad-CAM在ResNet-50中使用了预定等级. Box本地化使用地平地DINO中最有自信的预定对象盒,而SAM 2作为它的口罩提示接收了这个盒子. 质量、盒式中心或口罩式中间体的Grad-CAM中心对所要求的半平面进行测试。 盒和口罩分数将被忽略的检测数计为失败并使用所有生成的图像作为分母.

blocks.en: FID-50cls compares Inception-v3 features of the 1,000 generated images in each condition with the same 2,500 ImageNet validation images from the 50 evaluated classes. Appendix H Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录H 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: While QuadTok demonstrates strong potential in dynamic token allocation and structured autoregressive generation, our current study has two primary limitations.
blocks.zh: 四方时 托克显示出在动态符号分配和结构化自递生成方面的强大潜力,我们目前的研究有两个主要局限性。

blocks.en: Scale and Modality Constraints. First, due to computational resource limitations, our empirical evaluations are currently confined to class-conditional image generation on the ImageNet dataset. We have not yet scaled the framework to massive, open-domain datasets (e.g., LAION) nor extended the architecture to encompass complex text-to-image synthesis paradigms. Scaling the model capacity and extending the cross-attention mechanisms for open-vocabulary text conditioning require significantly more training compute and represent a critical next step.
blocks.zh: 规模和模式限制。 首先,由于计算资源的限制,我们的经验评价目前仅限于ImageNet数据集上的类条件图像生成。 我们尚未将框架缩放为大规模开放域数据集(例如LAION),也没有扩展架构以涵盖复杂的文本到图像合成范式. 扩大模型能力,扩大开放式语音文本调节的交叉注意机制,需要大量培训计算,这是关键的下一步。

blocks.en: Dataset Bias in Layout Control. Second, the inherent bias of the ImageNet dataset towards object-centric, single-subject compositions restricts the upper bound of our zero-shot spatial layout control. Although QuadTok effectively localizes primary subjects and separates them from the background based on topological priors, synthesizing highly complex, multi-object scenes with intricate relational layouts remains challenging. The model’s structural prior is naturally limited by the compositional diversity of its training data.
blocks.zh: 版式控制中的数据集 Bias 。 第二,ImageNet数据集对以对象为中心,单主体构成的固有偏差限制了我们零发空间布局控制的上限. 虽然QuadTok有效地将主题本地化,并且根据地貌学前科将其与背景区分开来,但是合成高度复杂,多对象的场景以及错综复杂的关系布局仍然具有挑战性. 该模型的结构先行性自然受到其培训数据结构多样性的限制。

blocks.en: We leave the scaling of QuadTok to large-scale text-to-image generation and its application to scene-level dataset for complex, multi-object layout control to future work.
blocks.zh: 我们把QuadTok的缩放到大规模文本到图像生成,并将其应用到场景级数据集,用于复杂的多对象布局控制,留待未来工作.
